outcome: Attitudes related to existential meaning in first-time mothers
cohort: First-time mothers who gave birth in Denmark in 2010, including all those who gave birth before the 32nd week of pregnancy and a randomly sampled group of full-term mothers twice the size.
finding: Attitudes related to existential meaning intensified to a similar degree among both full-term and preterm mothers, with no statistically significant differences based on various demographic factors.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in the intensification of attitudes related to existential meaning between first-time mothers who gave birth at full term and those who gave birth preterm, regardless of birth method.
